searchText: i am updating the ethereumjs client to devnet-3 specs and sync goes well until i request block number 100 from the bootnode, then i get an empty response if block num 100+ is included in the devp2p request range. i noticed this is mergeForkBlock, but it hasn't reached ttd, so i assume i should be able to continue syncing until the ttd block? Yes, did you implement the forkid correctly? Thanks <@!363800010518822915>! Could you also update the 'Nethermind-Prysm'-combo with this new (`--kintsugi-testnet`) parameter option? Also the Prysm command here mentions parameter `--interop-genesis-state`. I guess it must be `--genesis-state` in order to be consistent with the Geth-Prysm info (not sure what is the difference between the two). And I would kindly suggest to create some kind of "merge-testing"-channel in the Prysm discord to discuss Prysm merge specifics. I believe so, since I’m getting initial sync, I’ll double check in the morning, what should happen on/after block 100? Does the forkId update and fork_next becomes 0 again? I figure we’re not exchanging new status messages then so I wonder why would devp2p stop returning after number 100 🤔 I’ll read the changes more closely
